Vigorous antibacterial treat- ment may be needed if infection occurs (see Infections in Immunocompromised Patients, p.174) and plasma ex- change may alleviate the hyperviscosity syndrome.2,8,9 Drugs under investigation for the treatment of multiple myeloma include oblimersen, and arsenic trioxide.12 1.
